# Gothic 1 Remake Wiki
> Fan-made Gothic 1 Remake strategy guide, tools, and community resource. Covering lockpicking, faction guides, combat tips, walkthroughs, bestiary, and more. Updated daily.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://gothic-1-remake.com/): Main tool directory and site overview
- [Daily Tips & Events](https://gothic-1-remake.com/daily-tips.html): New tips, challenges, and events added daily
- [Lockpicking Solver](https://gothic-1-remake.com/lock-solver.html): Interactive BFS-based lock solution finder
- [Faction Choice Quiz](https://gothic-1-remake.com/factions-ultimate-guide.html): 3-question quiz to find your faction
- [Faction Comparison](https://gothic-1-remake.com/factions-guide.html): Old Camp vs New Camp vs Swamp Camp detailed comparison
- [Lockpicking Guide](https://gothic-1-remake.com/lockpicking.html): Step-by-step walkthrough with diagrams
- [Full Walkthrough](https://gothic-1-remake.com/walkthrough.html): Complete game walkthrough
- [Visual Guide](https://gothic-1-remake.com/visual-guide.html): Screenshot-based walkthrough
- [Map Guide](https://gothic-1-remake.com/map-guide.html): Maps and navigation tips

## Tools

- [Lockpicking Solver](https://gothic-1-remake.com/lock-solver.html): Enter lock pattern, get the correct sequence
- [Lockpicking Calculator](https://gothic-1-remake.com/lockpicking-calculator.html): Calculate lock combinations
- [Faction Quiz](https://gothic-1-remake.com/factions-ultimate-guide.html): Interactive faction choice helper

## About

Gothic 1 Remake is a modern rebuild of the 2001 cult classic RPG by Piranha Bytes, developed by Alkimia Interactive and published by THQ Nordic. This fan-made wiki provides free tools, guides, and resources for players. Not affiliated with THQ Nordic or Alkimia Interactive.
